title: Hunger Games Director Confirms Filmed Maysilee Scene Was Cut
excerpt:
Francis Lawrence says a major scene from the novel was filmed but removed.
The change reshaped Maysilee's relationship with Haymitch in the movie.
body_md:
Spoilers for The Hunger Games: Sunrise on the Reaping follow. Director Francis Lawrence has confirmed that a sequence involving Maysilee Donner killing a Gamemaker was filmed during production but did not make the final cut.

In the novel, the incident leads to a confrontation between Maysilee and Haymitch over his response to the Capitol. Lawrence explained that this disagreement no longer fit the film's portrayal of Haymitch and his efforts to undermine the arena.

Mckenna Grace, who plays Maysilee, also discussed the missing material. Removing the confrontation allowed the film to maintain a more unified relationship between the District 12 tributes and altered the emotional build-up to Maysilee's fate.

The filmmakers have not confirmed that the deleted scene will appear in a future home release.
